Notebook 8: Regex to Automaton (Kleene)

Interactive notebook on Kleene’s theorem: write a Regex, generate an NFA via Thompson’s construction, and explore state elimination and the R_i,j^k formulas.

Regex to Automaton & Kleene’s Theorem

This notebook explores the complete cycle of Kleene’s Theorem. You can type any Regular Expression. The notebook will automatically compile it into a Non-Deterministic Finite Automaton (NFA) using Thompson’s Construction, number its states, and allow you to explore the \(R_{i,j}^k\) sub-languages used in the state elimination method.

Remember that \(R_{i,j}^k\) represents the language (set of words) that takes the automaton from state \(q_i\) to \(q_j\) passing only through intermediate states with index \(\le k\).

The key recurrence is: \[ R_{i,j}^k = R_{i,j}^{k-1} + R_{i,k}^{k-1}(R_{k,k}^{k-1})^*R_{k,j}^{k-1} \]
